summary: A minimal, secure Python interpreter written in Rust, designed to safely execute Python code within AI applications and sandboxing scenarios.
usecases: Safe execution of user-generated Python code in AI-powered applications
Sandboxed code evaluation for LLM agents and tool use
Secure Python scripting in embedded or desktop AI tools
ideas: Integrate with local LLMs to allow code-based tool use with automatic sandbox cleanup
Use as a secure backend for AI-powered code editors or IDE plugins
Combine with Rust-based AI frameworks to enable safe, on-device code generation and execution
